title: Customer Support Executive - International Voice Process
description:
Role & responsibilities - Handle inbound calls from US customers. - Understand and resolve customer queries professionally. - Assist customers with orders, products, payments, returns and related concerns. - Provide accurate information and appropriate resolutions. - Maintain customer information and interaction records in the system. - Follow quality, compliance, productivity and attendance standards. - Maintain a positive and customer-focused approach throughout every interaction. 

 Preferred candidate profile - Excellent verbal and written English communication skills. - Candidates with International Voice / US Voice / International BPO experience preferred. - E-commerce, retail, customer service or inbound voice experience will be an added advantage. - Freshers with strong English communication skills may also be considered. - Good listening, interpersonal and problem-solving skills. - Comfortable working in rotational shifts and rotational weekly offs. - Comfortable handling US customers over voice calls. - Customer-focused, professional and confident personality. - Basic computer and typing skills. - Candidates willing to work with the organization for the long term preferred. - Immediate joiners / candidates with short notice period preferred.

Key Skills: Customer Support,BPO,Inbound Process,Inbound Voice Process,Inbound Customer Service,Customer Service,Customer Experience,Customer Care
